meta.name: obsidian-conversation-backup
meta.description: Automatic conversation backup system for Obsidian with incremental snapshots, hourly breakdowns, and formatted chat-style markdown. Use when setting up conversation archival, preventing data loss from /new resets, or organizing chat history in Obsidian vault with proper formatting (colored callouts, timestamps, multi-paragraph support).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动备份 Obsidian 对话记录为格式化 Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Obsidian 中聊天并担心 /new 重置导致数据丢失
copy.tagline_en: Automatically backup Obsidian conversations as formatted Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often chat in Obsidian and worry about data loss from /new resets

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 的对话会自动备份到 Obsidian 笔记库，生成带时间戳和彩色标注的 Markdown 文件。每小时增量保存新消息，防止 /new 重置导致数据丢失。
howto.when: 每小时自动触发增量备份（需配置 crontab）；也可手动运行脚本保存完整快照或按小时整理对话。

say.text: 帮我保存当前对话的完整快照，主题是“项目讨论”。
整理今天（2026-01-20）的对话，按小时拆分。

howto.what_en: Automatically backs up Claude conversations to Obsidian as formatted Markdown files with timestamps and colored callouts. Incremental snapshots every hour prevent data loss from /new resets.
howto.when_en: Triggers hourly via cron for incremental backups; also supports on-demand full snapshots and hourly breakdowns via manual scripts.

say_en.text: Save a full snapshot of the current conversation with topic 'project-discussion'.
